# What will your private pilot license really cost? Total, monthly budget and the price of every extra hour

> Free private pilot license cost calculator: flight hours, aircraft rental, instructor time, exam fees and gear become a total cost, a monthly budget, the price of each extra hour and a flying club versus renting comparison. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
